Every pedal is made by hand for YOU. /////////////////////////////////////////////// FIRST OFF... HEIMDALL-2 IS NOT AN HM2 "CLONE" A “clone” is an exact copy and the HEIMDALL design is neither exact or a copy. Also it is available in two different form factors: HEIMDALL-2 MKII A distortion, overdrive and powerful EQ with PARALLEL clean blend designed for LOW BARITONE tunings and BASS (although it works perfectly with all guitars, even standard tuned) think of it as the “deluxe” version of the two. HEIMDALL-3 A stripped down, compact version of the HEIMDALL-2 without the extra features for those wanting something more straightforward (and yet unique and versatile). /////////////////////////////////////////////// March 2026 REV-B update: The new revision B HEIMDALL-2 has dual power rails for twice the headroom so it’s not just a drive pedal anymore but also a great preamp. /////////////////////////////////////////////// While I love brutal caveman death metal, I am personally more inspired by GODFLESH (who used an HM2 without everything dimed) and wanted something that could get that streetcleaner tone and SO much more. The original version of the HEIMDALL seemingly endless hours of hard work where I never fully nailed what I was going for. Luckily my years of experience designing and building has allowed close to perfection of those sounds I was going for. The gain of the MKII is derived from an OP07 for more versatility. Capable of being more of a classic overdrive / distortion with the soft clipping and still have the ability to as gnarly / fuzzed-out as you want with the MOSFET hard-clipping. All while maintaining better articulation and note clarity than ever before. CONTROLS/////// • B=BASS • M=MID (sweepable) • H=HIGH MID • T=TREBLE • 🔱=GAIN • C=CLEAN • F=FREQUENCY (sweep control) • V=VOLUME Clean is PARALLEL This means the signals add together to become louder instead of the "blend" which caused a volume drop as the blend became cleaner. •RIGHT TOGGLE SWITCH adds a bass boost and low pass to the clean signal. •Clean can be set to boost above unity, acting as an un-effected boost in parallel with the distortion / EQ LEFT TOGGLE SWITCH • CLIPPING Three positions: -Left-MOSFET "hard clipping" (distortion/fuzz) -Middle-no clipping (dirty boost/drive) -Right-LED "soft clipping" (drive/distortion) F = frequency control is directly tied to the M = mid EQ control which has a sweepable frequency of 220hz-720hz. Inside you’ll notice there are SEVEN TRIM POTS: (not to worry, I've pre-set them before shipping) Many of you will immediately want to go in and tweak these. You can always refer to the close up photo of the trim pots to reset these.
